snippet.title: Virtua Fighter 4: Evolution playthrough (PS2, 1CC)
snippet.description: Playthrough with Wolf. This update to VF4 adds several new features, including 2 new characters. It also made the arcade mode a couple of stages shorter, which is great news for me, and the Wolf A.I. trick from the original still works here -just time his running clothesline right and you'll be OK.
